activeQuestion.prompt: What can the team do on Monday?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 團隊星期一可以做什麼？

options.text: Inspect the housings only after the new fixture is checked.
options.zh: 等新治具檢查完才檢查外殼。
options.whyZh: 檢查外殼不需治具，星期一即可進行。

options.text: Inspect the housings and assemble the full batch that day.
options.zh: 當天檢查外殼並完成整批組裝。
options.whyZh: 外殼可先檢查，但星期一治具還沒準備好，不能完成整批組裝。

options.text: Inspect the housings without the fixture and leave assembly for later.
options.zh: 不用治具先檢查外殼，組裝留待之後。
options.whyZh: 外殼檢查不依賴治具，可先進行；組裝要等治具準備好且完成檢查。

options.text: Inspect the housings using the new fixture as soon as it arrives that day.
options.zh: 當天治具一到就用它檢查外殼。
options.whyZh: 治具星期二才會準備好；外殼檢查也不需要它。

group.title: Revising the pilot build
group.passage:
Woman: We planned to assemble two hundred units in Monday's pilot build, but the new fixture will not be ready until Tuesday.
Man: Can the team start with the housing inspection on Monday? That does not require the fixture.
Woman: Yes. Assembly can move to Wednesday, after the fixture has been checked. I will update the schedule this afternoon.
Man: Please also tell purchasing that the material delivery date can stay the same.
group.passageZh:
女：我們原本計畫星期一試產組裝兩百台，但新治具要到星期二才會完成。
男：團隊星期一能先做外殼檢驗嗎？那不需要治具。
女：可以。治具檢查完成後，組裝可移到星期三。我今天下午會更新排程。
男：也請通知採購，物料交貨日期可以維持不變。
group.audioScript:

Yes. Assembly can move to Wednesday, after the fixture has been checked. I will update the schedule this afternoon.
Please also tell purchasing that the material delivery date can stay the same.
